name: Host
summary: The swarm knows which machine is alive without confusing host failure with provider failure.
hyperstition: The swarm knows which machine is alive without confusing host failure with provider failure.
myth: Bodies and planets may fail; the hive keeps the map of where flesh can still move.

engineering.pattern: compute node inventory + health check + worker-slot accounting
engineering.origin: cluster schedulers and systems monitoring; mature
engineering.exemplar: Oracle/OVH/Lenovo self-hosted runners and host telemetry

checks: host identity is distinct from provider/vendor/model
runner queue delay is separate from provider latency
host loss downgrades only dependent routes
